sources.title: Darwin-180B-RSI: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Darwin-180B-RSI is a 180-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts vision-language reasoning model from FINAL-Bench. Its parent is Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next; the model card says it retains the parent’s 512 routed experts, router, and vision encoder, and adds recursive self-improvement (RSI) from answers checked against verifiable references.
